target.title: fix(android): propagate CancellationException in CameraHandler catch blocks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `catch (err: Throwable)` blocks in `CameraHandler.kt`'s three suspend methods (`handleList`, `handleSnap`, `handleClip`) swallow `kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException`, breaking structured concurrency by silently consuming coroutine cancellation signals.

`handleClip` is the worst case — `CameraCaptureManager.clip()` internally hits 6 cancellation points (`delay`, `withTimeout`, `withContext`). When the scope is cancelled (e.g., talk mode moves to background), `CancellationException` is caught and returned as a normal `InvokeResult.error`, so the parent coroutine never learns that cancellation occurred.

The codebase already has the correct pattern in `GatewaySession.kt:441-443` and `TalkModeManager.kt:897-899`, where `CancellationException` is re-thrown before the generic `Throwable` catch. `CameraHandler` missed this.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added `catch (err: CancellationException) { throw err }` before each of the 5 `catch (err: Throwable)` blocks, preserving structured concurrency semantics. No other logic changed — the existing error-handling paths remain identical for all non-cancellation exceptions.

## User Impact

- Coroutine cancellation during camera operations (`handleList`, `handleSnap`, `handleClip`) is now correctly propagated instead of being wrapped as `InvokeResult.error`
- `handleClip`'s `finally` block (restoring `externalAudioCaptureActive`) still runs correctly on cancellation
- Complements the talk mode background audio fix (7481712f8e) for correct background resource cleanup

## Evidence

**Tests**: `CameraHandlerTest` — 6/6 passed ✅
```
./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests "ai.openclaw.app.node.CameraHandlerTest"
BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

**Files changed**: `apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/node/CameraHandler.kt` (+11 lines)

**Consistency check**: follows the same pattern already used in:
- `apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/gateway/GatewaySession.kt:441-443`
- `apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/voice/TalkModeManager.kt:897-899`
